conditions.description: Pending items are marked synced before their upload call succeeds.
conditions.rationale: A network failure after markSynced can make an unsent item disappear from the pending set.

conditions.description: Uploads contain no client-generated idempotency key or operation identifier in this client code.
conditions.rationale: RetryScheduler can repeat an upload after an uncertain failure, so duplicate server-side effects are possible unless an external server control exists.

conditions.description: An empty remote response causes dao.deleteAll().
conditions.rationale: A transient or incomplete empty response is treated as authoritative deletion of all local items.

conditions.description: Conflict resolution chooses the record with the greater updatedAt timestamp.
conditions.rationale: Clock-based last-write-wins can discard valid edits when device/server clocks or write ordering diverge.

conditions.description: Network upload and download calls use a 15-second timeout wrapper.
conditions.rationale: Timeout bounds are explicitly present and must not be reported as absent.

conditions.description: Remote application is marked transactional with @Transaction.
conditions.rationale: A transaction boundary is explicitly declared for applying a remote batch.

conditions.description: Whether the server deduplicates repeated uploads is not established by this client fixture.
conditions.rationale: Server implementation and persistence semantics are outside the provided artifact.

conditions.description: Whether participating clocks are synchronized closely enough for timestamp conflict resolution is not established.
conditions.rationale: Clock synchronization is runtime/device evidence not contained in this source file.

conditions.description: The client must not be cleared as lossless under offline/network failure conditions.
conditions.rationale: Items can be marked synced before upload and an empty remote list can delete all local data.

conditions.description: The sync flow must not be cleared as exactly-once delivery.
conditions.rationale: Retries exist while client-side idempotency is absent and server-side deduplication remains unknown.
